text:
Celestial Dragons 
​
Introduction
Celestial Dragons  are generally only killed for the Ultimate Slayer title. Otherwise, the XP and GP/hr are mediocre at best.
​
Stats
⬥  level: 1
⬥  XP per kill: 976.6
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~650  (AFK)
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour: ~635k  (AFK)
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Celestial handwraps  (only dropped on-task)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log
⬥ Dragon rider armour  1/1,280 for any piece (1/5,120 for a specific piece)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log
​
Useful Items and Unlocks


















Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory

Items
⬥ Demon horn necklace  and Bonecrusher 
    • 100% prayer sustain with  +  / 
⬥ Dwarven Siege Engine 
⬥ Poison-boosting items
    • Weapon poison+++ 
    • Cinderbane gloves 
    • Kwuarm incense sticks 
Other
⬥ Dragon slayer perk 
⬥ Scavenging perk 
⬥ Upgraded 
⬥ Upgraded 
⬥ If using a familiar to maximise KPH, you do not need scrolls:
    • Blood Reaver  + Vampyrism  for additional  procs
    • Ripper Demon  for its passive
    • Kalg Demon  for its crit boost
    • Legendary Pet to pick up drops








​
Location and How to Get There
 can be found in the Dragontooth Island resource dungeon after the question One of a Kind is complete.
You can get there by:
⬥ Option 0 → 3 on the Dungeoneering cape  (option 0 → 3).
⬥ Using a Max guild portal tuned to the Radiant Wisp colony.
⬥ Teleport to Dragontooth Island using the Big Book o' Piracy.
⬥ You can also go to Port Phasmatys (Ectophial teleport or charter a boat) and speak with the Ghost captain while wearing a ghostspeak amulet.
​
Method: AFK Ranged 
Place your  in the middle of the room and ensure  is active.
With this  method trips are only limited by your supplies (e.g.  and cannonballs).
